mechanic: Fullscreen JS-crossfading hero video under a liquid-glass UI, followed by framer-motion useInView fade-and-rise reveals down a bg-black scroll of glass video cards and Instrument-Serif italic editorial headings.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + framer-motion + lucide-react; Instrument Serif via Google Fonts @import, .liquid-glass defined in index.css @layer components.
reskinNotes: The .liquid-glass effect bakes white-alpha gradients, inset highlights and a masked 1.4px border directly into CSS, so a non-white/non-dark brand palette requires editing those rgba stops rather than a single token. Headline emphasis (italic all, 'x', etc.) and all body copy are hardcoded inline in JSX. Hero text uses whitespace-nowrap at text-9xl, so longer headlines will overflow on narrow viewports. The hero crossfade timing (500ms fade, 0.55s tail trigger) assumes a short seamless-loop clip; long or non-loopable footage will read as an abrupt cut.
